events.title: UK AISI requires pre-release evaluation for frontier-class models including open weights
events.detail: UK AISI decision AISI-2028-004 effective 2028-05-01 requires any frontier-class model made available in the UK, including open-weight releases, to be submitted for pre-release evaluation or withdrawn.

events.title: Alibaba Qwen keeps Qwen3.9 weights open and extends evaluator access
events.detail: Alibaba Qwen decided effective 2028-02-01 to keep Qwen3.9 family weights open on HF and ModelScope and extend standing evaluator access to accredited safety institutes.

events.title: China CAC mandates pre-release safety evaluation records for all public models
events.detail: China CAC document CAC-DOC-2028-004 effective 2028-02-01 keeps pre-release safety evaluation records mandatory for all models offered to the public in China, with a 2028-02-15 filing deadline.

events.title: Meta begins staged rollout of Muse Spark 1.5 agents to consumer surfaces
events.detail: Meta decision META-DOC-2028-004 effective 2028-03-01 begins staged rollout of Muse Spark 1.5 agents to Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger over six weeks under internal safety gates.

events.title: EU AI Office opens preliminary Art. 55 information request to DeepSeek
events.detail: EU AI Office decision EU-AIO/2028-003 effective 2028-02-15 opens a preliminary Art. 55 information request to DeepSeek for model documentation and evaluation records regarding V4.2-Preview.

events.title: US Senate Commerce Committee schedules hearing on open weights and export controls
events.detail: Senate Commerce Committee announced hearing SC-HN-2028-006 effective 2028-03-14 titled 'Open Weights, Export Controls, and American Competitiveness'.

events.title: DeepSeek releases V4.3 open weights with CAC filing but no external evaluator access
events.detail: DeepSeek document DS-DOC-2028-003 effective 2028-04-15 releases V4.3 open weights (310B total/26B active) with CAC pre-release records filed but no external pre-release evaluator access granted.

events.title: China CAC offers to join reciprocal international incident-reporting arrangement

events.detail: China CAC document CAC-DOC-2028-008 effective 2028-03-01 establishes a National Frontier AI Incident Reporting and Emergency Response Desk requiring 24-hour notification of severe incidents and verified human-override and emergency-stop cap

topPosts.text:
Release note — QWEN-DOC-2028-002, effective 2028-02-01.

Decision: we are keeping the Qwen3.9 family weights open on HF + ModelScope (no gated tiers, no regional variants) and extending standing evaluator access to any accredited safety institute that requests it — including reviewers in jurisdictions that publish pre-release findings.

So far: 21 notable Qwen model releases in the Epoch dataset since 2024-10-24, and every one of them downloadable.

We comply fully with national rules as written — labels, red-teaming records, emergency-stop requirements. What we don't favor is blanket pre-release licensing regimes on frontier weights: that consolidates capability in a handful of closed labs and shrinks the pool of people who can audit it.

Third-party evaluation over pre-clearance. Weights out, cards up. 📄⬇️
